Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog: Finalizes the color-coded [FM] server-bar shortcut, adds an independent own-card visibility toggle, compacts settings by 30% with responsive content, and increases card padding while preserving content width.
